notablePrerequisites: If desired, you have another instant or sorcery card in hand with mana to cast it.
description:
Cast any instant or sorcery spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting the spell.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Reiterate, targeting the original Reiterate.
Resolve the copy of Reiterate, copying Reiterate targeting the original Reiterate.
Repeat step 4.
